# Persisted S3-compatible fixture

`s3db-v21-objects.json` is a provider-independent object capture of the fixture
generated by unmodified s3db.js 21.6.2 at commit
`8264a009ce46b6f5b6e8a30a8916e9608fbffc11`. The capture retains every key, body,
metadata header, and content type needed by an S3-compatible provider.

Run `node adapters/s3/tests/fixtures/generate-from-filesystem.mjs` to reproduce it
from the filesystem fixture. The S3 compatibility test writes the captured objects
with the AWS SDK, opens them through Baldin, and compares the provider's object
listing before and after the read.
